fonts.heading: Cormorant Garamond
fonts.accent: Space Mono (for labels and numbers only)

scale.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-8xl tracking-tighter leading-[0.9]

typography.guidelines: Do not use Inter or Space Grotesk. Headings should heavily utilize Cormorant Garamond, mixing regular and italic words for editorial tension. Never center-align massive text blocks.

colors.guidelines: Never use pure white or pure black. No AI-slop purple gradients. Emphasize organic, matte, architectural colors that evoke wood, stone, and clay.

spacing_and_layout.guidelines: Use 2x normal spacing. Embrace negative space. Use 'Tetris' bento grids (asymmetrical spans like col-span-5 next to col-span-7). Optical alignment over geometric.

motion_and_interaction.hero_reveal: Framer Motion: Masked line-by-line upward text reveal on load (overflow: hidden, y: 100% to 0, staggerChildren: 0.15).
motion_and_interaction.scrolling: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Required for premium feel.
motion_and_interaction.parallax: Subtle framer-motion useScroll & useTransform for hero background image y-axis translation.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Portfolio cards: Clipped frame (scale 0.95 inside container) expands to scale 1.05 on hover. Spotlight effect on dark sections.
motion_and_interaction.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Extremely slow, smooth, serif font, large gaps (gap-32), pale background with dark earthy text.

buttons.primary: bg-walnut text-inverse px-8 py-4 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-sm hover:bg-terracotta transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: border border-walnut/20 text-text-primary px-8 py-4 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-sm hover:bg-walnut hover:text-inverse transition-colors

cards.services: border-b border-subtle py-8 flex justify-between items-center hover:bg-white/50 transition-colors group cursor-pointer

forms.input: bg-transparent border-b border-subtle py-4 px-0 rounded-none focus:outline-none focus:border-walnut focus:ring-0 w-full text-lg
forms.guidelines: Do not use standard Vercel/Shadcn rounded inputs. Use architectural single-bottom-border inputs.

navigation.header: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F4F1EB]/80 border-b border-subtle transition-all
navigation.guidelines: Do not use fully transparent header backgrounds to ensure text remains readable over images.

page_blueprint.1_header: Sticky crystal glass nav. Left: Logo, Middle: Links, Right: 'Get a Quote' button.
page_blueprint.2_hero: Kinetic typography. Large headline 'CRAFTING TIMELESS SPACES'. Line-by-line reveal. Right/bottom aligned high-end interior photo with subtle parallax.
page_blueprint.3_marquee: Slow editorial ribbon displaying 'MR. WOOD INTERIORS — JAIPUR — CUSTOM FURNITURE — PREMIUM CRAFTSMANSHIP'.
page_blueprint.4_manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03). Massive numbers in Space Mono. Heavy serif text outlining the design/build process.
page_blueprint.5_services: Minimalist accordion or hover-image list for Modular Kitchens, Wardrobes, TV Units, False Ceiling, Office Furniture.
page_blueprint.6_portfolio: Asymmetrical masonry grid of past projects. Clipped frames with image scaling on hover.
page_blueprint.7_why_choose_us: Dark section (bg-dark_section). Text-inverse. Trust indicators for local SEO (Jaipur's Best, 10+ Years, etc).
page_blueprint.8_testimonials: Large quote text taking up 80% of width. Author details bottom right.
page_blueprint.9_faq: Clean accordion for AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) targeting interior design queries.
page_blueprint.10_contact_lead: Split layout. Left: Showroom map, NAP details. Right: Minimalist lead capture form.
page_blueprint.11_footer: Massive typography 'MR. WOOD' across the bottom. Links and social.
page_blueprint.12_widgets: Sticky WhatsApp + Call action buttons. AI Design Assistant chat widget bottom right.

media_and_images.guidelines: No placeholders. Use specific architectural and interior photography. Use overlays (bg-black/30) only if text is directly on top of images.

testing.accessibility: Ensure all interactive and key informational elements have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='quote-form').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Use .js files (JSX) instead of .tsx where applicable.
Do not apply generic 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Implement glass-morphism effectively but NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds where text readability is compromised.
Do not use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 💡, etc.) for UI icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Prioritize HTML/Tailwind over Shadcn for complex marketing layouts like the Hero, Marquee, and Manifesto grids.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover/active states.
Use 2-3x more spacing than default to create a premium, uncrowded feel.
Never use placeholder URLs; rely strictly on the provided image URLs.
